observations: Black cylindrical plastic water tank with ribbed sides, typical vertical overhead/storage tank shape.
Tank surface shows dirt, white staining and scuff marks, suggesting it is used or has been stored outdoors for a while.
A white rectangular label is visible on the top dome in both photos, but no text on it is legible.
No brand name, logo, or capacity markings are readable anywhere on the tank body in either photo.
Background shows multiple similar tanks stacked, indicating a stock/dealer yard rather than a single private sale.
A watermark 'CREDIBLE BUSINESS SOLUTIONS' overlays photo 1, seller's own branding, not the tank's.

claims.evidence: No Geepee logo or embossed brand text visible on the tank in photo 0 or photo 1; the only label present is blank/illegible.
No capacity markings or size reference (e.g. tape measure, person) in either photo; size can't be confirmed from image alone.

claims.claim: for water and other valuable storage
claims.evidence: General usability claim; no leak test, no water-fill demonstration, no interior view.

risks.risk: Actual capacity could be smaller than claimed 4000ltrs.
risks.proof: Photo with a measuring tape against the tank height/diameter, or a visible embossed capacity marking.
risks.if_unproven: priced as the smallest common size that matches the visual proportions, not as 4000ltrs

risks.risk: Tank may be used/old rather than new, affecting wall integrity and lifespan.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the base and any dent/crack areas, plus seller confirmation of age and purchase date.

risks.risk: No inlet/outlet fittings or lid seal shown, which affects installation cost.
risks.proof: Photo of the underside outlet point and the lid closed/sealed.
risks.if_unproven: priced as missing fittings (buyer must add cost)

risks.risk: Possible hairline cracks or leaks not visible in static photos.
risks.proof: A short video of the tank being tapped/filled with water showing no leakage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed leak-free, i.e. as a working-uncertain unit

proof_requests: Close-up of any embossed brand/capacity marking on the tank body or base.
A photo with a tape measure or known-size object next to the tank for scale.
Photo or video of the outlet/fitting area underneath the tank.
Short video showing the tank filled or tapped to confirm no leaks or cracks.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a vertical plastic water storage tank by type, but the claimed brand and 4000ltr capacity cannot be confirmed from the photos, so it must be priced at the worst-case generic, unverified-capacity, used-condition level until proof is given.
